workflow_details.description: Add information that will help to differentiate this workflow from another.
workflow_details.title: Workflow Details

data_source.description: Select one of your configured data sources.

what.title: What this run should do
what.description: Create the WD standard model, or copy event types from another instance. The fields shown change with the choice, and only those are read.

dry_run.title: Dry run - create nothing
dry_run.description: Leave ON to create nothing and just list what is missing. Turn it off to write. There is no undo in EarthRanger: a category cannot be safely deleted and an event type that has taken one record cannot be removed.

activate.title: Activate the event types immediately
activate.description: Create the event types ACTIVE. A category with no active types is invisible in EarthRanger to everyone, superusers included -- so with this off you will see nothing until you activate them. Note that a new category's permissions start with only the account running this, so nobody else can see it either way.

prefix.title: Event type prefix (blank for a real build)
prefix.description: Prefix every event type value, e.g. 'trw_' for a rehearsal. Values are unique per instance, so an unprefixed test build takes the name the real one needs later.

replace_schema.title: Replace schemas that already exist
replace_schema.description: Also rewrite the schema of event types that already exist. Off by default: it would replace a live form, possibly one somebody else built.

CopyFromInstance.description: Bring event types across from another EarthRanger instance.

source.description: The instance the event types are read from. Only ever read, never written to.
source.title: Instance to copy from

from_categories.description: Event CATEGORY values as they are on the source, e.g. 'field_monitoring' -- not the display names. Every v2 event type in them comes across, with its choice lists. Categories rather than individual types because a whole model is two or three values rather than twenty-seven. There is no dropdown: Desktop cannot list options from a connection that sits inside a choice like this one. A dry run checks each value against the source and names the near misses for anything it cannot find, so run one first.
from_categories.title: Categories to copy (type one value per row)

species.description: 'source' keeps whatever species list the copied forms already use. 'standard' repoints them at the WD standard 66-entry list. 'csv' repoints them at a list built from a file of your own. Only the GENERAL species list is moved -- purpose-specific ones such as livestock or vulture species are left alone, and every list picked or declined is reported as a row.
species.title: Species list for the copied forms

species_csv.description: Path to a CSV with value, display and an optional ordernum column. Validated in full before anything is written.
species_csv.title: Species CSV (only read when 'csv' is chosen above)

into_category.description: Leave empty to keep each type in the category it has on the source. Set it to file everything under one category instead. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; it is created if it is not already there.
into_category.title: Put them all in this category (blank = keep the source's)

collision_prefix.description: If a choice list arriving from the source has the same name as one already on the target but different options, give the incoming one this prefix. Only clashing lists are renamed; ones that already match are shared. Leave empty to skip them instead, in which case the forms bind to the target's version and any rule keyed on a missing value silently never fires.
collision_prefix.title: Prefix for clashing choice lists (e.g. fm_)

CopyFromInstance.title: Copy event types from another instance

StandardModel.description: Create the WD standard model from the categories chosen here.

categories.description: Which parts of the standard model to set up. Leave all selected for the whole thing; Rangeland Monitoring is the one most sites leave out.

species_list.description: Leave empty to create the standard 66-entry species list. To use a list this instance already has, name it here and every species field is repointed at it instead of a second list being created.
species_list.title: Use a species list already on this instance

species_csv.description: Path to a CSV of species to create instead of the standard list. Needs a header row and the columns value,display with an optional ordernum -- for example: grevys_zebra,Grevy's Zebra,10 . 'value' is stored on every record and is matched by the form's conditionals, so it must be lowercase letters, digits and underscores, and it can never be changed once data exists. The whole file is checked before anything is written.
species_csv.title: Or load species from a CSV file

StandardModel.title: Set up the WD standard model
